posts.title: A fresh design for the site
posts.description: I’ve given christianengvall.se a fresh design. The site had been running on the same WordPress-migrated theme for years. I rebuilt it from the ground up as a light, calm portfolio — new typography (Outfit for headlines, IBM Plex for everything else), a green accent, and a lot less visual noise. posts.title: Update pihole running in a Docker container
posts.description: The Pihole web interface tells you to run pihole -up to get the latest version. But if you are running pihole as a docker container we need to do it a little bit different. To update pihole; Open a terminal and do the following: Stop the container: docker stop pihole Pull the latest Pihole docker pull pihole/pihole Remove your existing pihole container docker rm -f pihole Start container #Dependin
